name: nebula-token/nebula-token
description: Opaque rotating refresh tokens (RFC 9700 model): rotation, reuse detection, family revocation, sender binding.

nebula-token.note: This is the one and only manifest for the PHP package, and it sits at the repository root because Packagist reads composer.json from a repository root only. NEBULA is a ten-language monorepo; the PHP sources are packages/php. The dist archive is trimmed to PHP by the export-ignore rules in the root .gitattributes -- Composer builds it with git archive, which honours them -- so a consumer downloads PHP, LICENSE and README.md and none of the other nine languages. There is deliberately no "version" key: Packagist reads the git tag, and a version key here would silently override it.
